command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$xs=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes'; foreach (`$x in `$xs) { `$n=`$x.name; `$cl=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/commands'); `$keys=@(`$cl.commands.command_key); if (`$keys -contains 'display_current-configuration') { `$cmd='display%20current-configuration' } elseif (`$keys -contains 'show_running-config') { `$cmd='show%20running-config' } else { continue }; try { `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output -split '\r?\n'; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output -split '\r?\n'; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$b -DifferenceObject `$a | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -match '(?i)(isis|mpls|static|route|ospf|bgp|interface|shutdown|vlan|stp|mst|vrrp|nat|ip address|vpn|policy|track|mtu|traffic|bandwidth|edge|bpdu|hrp|prefix|access-list|security|cost)' -and `$_.InputObject -notmatch '(?i)(certificate|trustpoint|license|Current configuration|Last configuration)' }; if (`$d) { Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' ==='); `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize } } catch { Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' compare failed ===') } }"
